articles.title: India builds domestic tunnel boring machines for Himalayan rail project
articles.summary: India is advancing domestic manufacturing of tunnel boring machines as construction continues on the one hundred twenty five kilometre Rishikesh to Karnaprayag railway line in Uttarakhand. Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that domestic plants now produce eight metre and fifteen metre machines to navigate difficult Himalayan geology. The infrastructure project will feature sixteen tunnels, significantly improving regional connectivity upon completion.
articles.title_hi: भारत हिमालय रेल परियोजना के लिए घरेलू सुरंग खोदने वाली मशीनें बनाता है
articles.summary_hi: भारत सुरंग खोदने वाली मशीनों के घरेलू विनिर्माण को आगे बढ़ा रहा है क्योंकि उत्तराखंड में एक सौ पच्चीस किलोमीटर लंबी ऋषिकेश से कर्णप्रयाग रेलवे लाइन पर निर्माण जारी है। रेल मंत्री अश्विनी वैष्णव ने कहा कि घरेलू संयंत्र अब कठिन हिमालयी भूविज्ञान को नेविगेट करने के लिए आठ मीटर और पंद्रह मीटर मशीनों का उत्पादन करते हैं। बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजना में सोलह सुरंगें होंगी, जिसके पूरा होने पर क्षेत्रीय कनेक्टिविटी में उल्लेखनीय सुधार होगा।
articles.title_hinglish: bharata himalaya rela pariyojana ke lie gharelu suranga khodane vali mashinen banata hai
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata suranga khodane vali mashinon ke gharelu vinirmana ko aage badhaा raha hai kyonki uttarakhanda men eka sau pachchisa kilomitara lanbi rishikesha se karnaprayaga relave laina para nirmana jari hai। rela mantri ashvini vaishnava ne kaha ki gharelu sanyantra aba kathina himalayi bhuvijnyana ko nevigeta karane ke lie aatha mitara aura pandraha mitara mashinon ka utpadana karate hain। buniyadi dhancha pariyojana men solaha surangen hongi, jisake pura hone para kshetriya kanektiviti men ullekhaniya sudhara hoga।

articles.title: Sooryavanshi storm brewing as India, New Zealand gear up for another run fest
articles.summary: Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi will return for India in the second Twenty20 International against New Zealand in Christchurch on Saturday. Following an injury to Ishan Kishan, the youngster is expected to open the batting. India leads the series after a high-scoring opener, while New Zealand aims to bounce back using their powerful batting lineup and spin options.

articles.title: New movies and shows arrive on streaming platforms this week
articles.summary: Streaming platforms release nine new movies and shows this week across various genres for audiences to enjoy. Actor Nani stars in The Telugu period drama titled The Paradise. The romantic comedy series Nobody Wants This returns for its third season. Manoj Bajpayee stars in Gajab Raat as a police officer entangled in a murder conspiracy.
articles.title_hi: इस सप्ताह स्ट्रीमिंग प्लेटफॉर्म पर नई फिल्में और शो आएंगे
articles.summary_hi: स्ट्रीमिंग प्लेटफॉर्म इस सप्ताह दर्शकों के आनंद के लिए विभिन्न शैलियों में नौ नई फिल्में और शो रिलीज करेंगे। अभिनेता नानी द पैराडाइज़ नामक तेलुगु पीरियड ड्रामा में अभिनय कर रहे हैं। रोमांटिक कॉमेडी सीरीज़ नोबडी वांट्स दिस अपने तीसरे सीज़न के साथ वापस आ रही है। गजब रात में मनोज बाजपेयी एक हत्या की साजिश में फंसे पुलिस अधिकारी की भूमिका में हैं।

articles.title: Delayed transfers cleared: Gujarat relieves primary teachers waiting since 2022
articles.summary: Gujarat education department has ordered the complete relieving of primary school teachers who have been awaiting district or taluka transfers since 2022-23 despite receiving transfer orders. The decision provides relief to teachers whose transfers were stalled due to the rule requiring schools to maintain at least 50% of their sanctioned staff strength.

articles.title: Delhi Police Transfers All 57 Protest FIRs To Crime Branch
articles.summary: The Delhi Police has transferred all fifty-seven first information reports linked to the Jantar Mantar demonstration to the Crime Branch. Authorities cited high workload and case sensitivity for the decision. The move aims to unify the ongoing probe into a single coordinated investigation. Officials hope this reorganization will streamline the judicial process moving forward.
articles.title_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस ने विरोध प्रदर्शन की सभी 57 एफआईआर क्राइम ब्रांच को ट्रांसफर कीं
articles.summary_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस ने जंतर-मंतर प्रदर्शन से जुड़ी सभी सत्तावन प्रथम सूचना रिपोर्ट को अपराध शाखा को स्थानांतरित कर दिया है। अधिकारियों ने इस निर्णय के लिए उच्च कार्यभार और मामले की संवेदनशीलता का हवाला दिया। इस कदम का उद्देश्य चल रही जांच को एकल समन्वित जांच में एकीकृत करना है। अधिकारियों को उम्मीद है कि यह पुनर्गठन आगे चलकर न्यायिक प्रक्रिया को सुव्यवस्थित करेगा।

articles.title: Central Forensic Science Laboratory Report Links Four Accused to Bawana Rape and Murder
articles.summary: A Central Forensic Science Laboratory DNA report has linked all four accused men to the rape and murder of a minor in outer Delhi. Police stated that Y-STR test results match the victim samples, supporting the ongoing sexual assault investigation. This evidence strengthens the case as authorities move forward with legal proceedings against the suspects involved.

articles.title: Indian Union Muslim League Promises Action Over Doha Office Heist
articles.summary: The Indian Union Muslim League has promised strict action following fresh allegations linking organization members to a major theft. Over three million Qatari riyals were stolen from the Doha office of the Kerala Muslim Cultural Centre. The incident has deepened an ongoing mystery as investigators examine potential internal involvement in the high-profile financial crime.
articles.title_hi: इंडियन यूनियन मुस्लिम लीग ने दोहा कार्यालय डकैती पर कार्रवाई का वादा किया
articles.summary_hi: इंडियन यूनियन मुस्लिम लीग ने संगठन के सदस्यों को एक बड़ी चोरी से जोड़ने के ताजा आरोपों के बाद सख्त कार्रवाई का वादा किया है। केरल मुस्लिम सांस्कृतिक केंद्र के दोहा कार्यालय से तीन मिलियन से अधिक कतरी रियाल चोरी हो गए। इस घटना ने एक रहस्य को और गहरा कर दिया है क्योंकि जांचकर्ता हाई-प्रोफाइल वित्तीय अपराध में संभावित आंतरिक भागीदारी की जांच कर रहे हैं।

articles.summary_hinglish: indiyana yuniyana muslima liga ne sangathana ke sadasyon ko eka badaी chori se jodane ke taja aaropon ke bada sakhta karravaee ka vada kiya hai। kerala muslima sanskritika kendra ke doha karyalaya se tina miliyana se adhika katari riyala chori ho gae। isa ghatana ne eka rahasya ko aura gahara kara diya hai kyonki janchakarta haee-prophaila vittiya aparadha men sanbhavita aantarika bhagidari ki jancha kara rahe hain।

articles.title: Indian Foreign Minister Visits Azerbaijan To Reset Bilateral Relations
articles.summary: India External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev and Foreign Minister Jeyhun Bayramov in Baku on October 23, 2026. The visit marks an effort to reset diplomatic ties after previous friction over regional disputes. Both ministers discussed enhancing cooperation in energy, trade, tourism, and connectivity while addressing common threats like terrorism to foster mutual progress.

articles.title: Talks between Ladakh groups, MHA fail to resume amid rift over govt. proposal
articles.summary: The CSFL comprises BJP leader and ex-Member of Parliament Thupstan Chhewang, ex-chief executive councillor of the Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council-Leh (LAHDC-Leh) Rigzen Spalbar; ex-legislator Tsering Samphel, representatives of Thiksey and Thuksey Rinpoche, and also members of the Ladakh Buddhist Association (LBA). It urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah “to take note of the ground reality”.

articles.title: Two Tripura schools earn recognition in Education World Rankings
articles.summary: Tripura has once again brought laurels to the Northeast with two of its prominent schools earning recognition in the latest India School Rankings by EducationWorld, highlighting the state’s growing reputation for quality education. Ramakrishna Mission Vidyalaya, Viveknagar, Agartala, has secured a place among the Top 20 Schools in India, according to the assessment and accreditation conducted by EducationWorld.

articles.title: Lemon Tree Hotels signs 63-room Keys Lite property in Bhilwara, Rajasthan
articles.summary: With this addition, the group will have 14 operational hotels and 10 upcoming properties in the state. The hotel will be managed by Carnation Hotels Private Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Lemon Tree Hotels. The property will feature 63 rooms, a restaurant, banquet facilities, a meeting and conference room, a fitness centre and other public areas.
articles.title_hi: लेमन ट्री होटल्स ने राजस्थान के भीलवाड़ा में 63 कमरों वाली कीज़ लाइट संपत्ति पर हस्ताक्षर किए

articles.title: Petrol bomb attacksAdmin in constant touch with community leaders
articles.summary: Shillong, Oct 23: Keeping in view the back-to-back petrol bomb attacks in Shillong, the East Khasi Hills district administration has taken up the two prime tasks of building public confidence and tracking down the attackers. Deputy commissioner Abhilash Baranwal said sector magistrates and district officers are in constant touch with Rangbah Shnong, headmen and community leaders to reassure residents.

articles.title: Indian kabaddi teams secure dominant opening wins at Commonwealth championship
articles.summary: India's men and women kabaddi teams secured dominant opening victories at the Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship on Friday. The women defeated Malaysia seventy-three to thirteen, while the men triumphed over England forty-six to twenty-six. The women will face Singapore next, and the men will play against Uganda on Saturday in their upcoming matches.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय कबड्डी टीमों ने कॉमनवेल्थ चैंपियनशिप में शुरुआती जीत हासिल की

articles.title: Nagaland: Private Doctors play important role on TB treatment
articles.summary: •     48. 2% people seek health care in private sector •     Dimapur records highest number of TB cases in Nagaland Morung Express News Dimapur | October 23  Dimapur has the highest number of tuberculosis (TB) cases in Nagaland, which is a cause for concern, Chief Medical Officer (CMO) Dr T Yetovi Tuccu said.

articles.title: Karnataka pitches itself as Poland technology and innovation gateway to India
articles.summary: Karnataka ministers met the prime minister of Poland in Bengaluru to strengthen cooperation across investment and technology. Officials presented the local innovation ecosystem, highlighting artificial intelligence capabilities, a massive startup valuation, and a large talent pool. The meeting aims to create digital corridors and expand bilateral economic partnerships between both regions.
articles.title_hi: कर्नाटक खुद को भारत के लिए पोलैंड प्रौद्योगिकी और नवाचार प्रवेश द्वार के रूप में पेश करता है

articles.title: Pakistan aims to host 2028 Women T20 World Cup with neutral UAE venue
articles.summary: Pakistan intends to host the International Cricket Council 2028 Women Twenty20 World Cup, while the United Arab Emirates will likely serve as a neutral venue for Indian matches under a hybrid model. The tournament is scheduled from September seven to October one, 2028. This arrangement follows previous hybrid agreements used to manage matches between India and Pakistan.

articles.title: Thousands stage 'sound protest' in Manipur over killings, tear gas fired to disperse
articles.summary: IMPHAL: Thousands of people across Manipur's five valley districts took to the streets on Friday evening to stage a "sound protest" against continued killings and alleged government's failure to restore normalcy in the state. Protesters in different localities of Imphal banged utensils, struck electric poles with hammers and honked vehicle horns between 7.

articles.summary: A coalition of students, farmers and civil society groups has joined calls for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over India's voter roll revision exercise. articles.title: Indian Para Athletes Achieve Record Haul at Asian Para Games
articles.summary: Indian para-athletes achieved their best ever performance at the Asian Para Games by securing a record-shattering haul of 114 medals in total. This historic collection included 30 gold medals, following an impressive flourish on the final day of the competition. The exceptional results surpassed all prior expectations for the national team, marking a major milestone for Indian sports.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय पैरा एथलीटों ने एशियाई पैरा खेलों में रिकॉर्ड उपलब्धि हासिल की

articles.title_hinglish: bharatiya paira ethaliton ne eshiyaee paira khelon men rikorda upalabdhi hasila ki
articles.summary_hinglish: bharatiya paira-ethaliton ne eshiyaee paira khelon men kula 114 padakon ka rikorda toda rikorda hasila karake apana aba taka ka sarvashreshtha pradarshana hasila kiya। pratiyogita ke antima dina prabhavashali pradarshana ke bad, isa aitihasika sangraha men 30 svarna padaka shamila the। asadharana parinama rashtriya tima ke lie sabhi purva apekshaon se badhakara rahe, jo bharatiya khelon ke lie eka badaा mila ka patthara hai।

articles.title: Reserve Bank of India Tightens Operational Risk Capital Norms for Banks
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has revised operational risk capital norms for banks. The new rules cover income classification, derivative valuations, and historical loss data. They become effective on April 1, 2027. Under the financial component, banks must separately classify gains and losses from trading book and banking book activities in line with regulatory directions.

articles.title: French bond selloff raises debt concerns across Europe amid social unrest
articles.summary: European bond markets have stabilised following a volatile week of trading. However, a persistent French bond selloff is raising fresh debt concerns across the continent amid ongoing social unrest. This development highlights continued fragility in regional financial stability as investors closely monitor sovereign debt levels and broader economic conditions in European markets.
articles.title_hi: सामाजिक अशांति के बीच फ्रांसीसी बांड सेलऑफ़ ने पूरे यूरोप में ऋण संबंधी चिंताएँ बढ़ा दी हैं

articles.title: Actor RJ Mitte Known For Breaking Bad Passes Away At Age 34
articles.summary: Actor RJ Mitte, who played Walter White Junior in the television show Breaking Bad, has died at the age of thirty-four. Authorities reportedly identified his death as suicide. Bryan Cranston shared an emotional tribute to his former on-screen son. Mitte was diagnosed with cerebral palsy as a child and used his platform to champion disability awareness and inclusion.

articles.title: Vadodara Civic Body Approves Controversial Land Plot Transfer to Yusuf Pathan
articles.summary: The Vadodara Municipal Corporation standing committee approved transferring a residential plot to former cricketer and Member of Parliament Yusuf Pathan on Friday. Congress workers protested the decision in Gujarat, calling it an unfair distribution of public property. Pathan will receive part of the land as a gift and pay for the rest at a concessional rate.

articles.title: BCCI appoints former India pacer Parvinder Awana as Junior Selection Committee chairperson
articles.summary: "The Cricket Advisory Committee (CAC) conducted a selection process for the appointment of members to the Junior Cricket Committee. The CAC screened and interviewed applicants and, following the process, recommended the appointment of Parvinder Awana as Chairman, along with Krishna Das, Rakesh Patel and N. Arjun Yadav as members of the Committee," BCCI said in a statement.

articles.title: Swadeshi Jagaran Manch urges Narendra Modi to block Starlink in India
articles.summary: The Swadeshi Jagaran Manch urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to deny operating permissions for SpaceX satellite internet service Starlink in New Delhi on October 23, 2026. Citing national security concerns, the affiliate of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh advocated for developing a homegrown satellite network instead. The Union government has not yet approved spectrum allotment requests for three companies.

articles.title: India requires a new collaborative agenda for its evolving space ecosystem
articles.summary: Speaking at a seminar on Friday, Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology Vice-Chancellor Dipankar Banerjee stated that India needs a new collaborative agenda for its space sector. As demand grows and Space 3.0 emerges, the country must unite industry, academia, and start-ups. Officials noted that space technology is transforming into a major industry.

articles.title: Pratika Rawal and Shree Charani lead India to victory over Zimbabwe
articles.summary: Pratika Rawal scored a century and Shree Charani took four wickets to help India defeat Zimbabwe by nine wickets in the opening women's one-day international cricket match in Vadodara on Friday. Rawal recorded her third century while Charani claimed career-best figures. The victory gives India an early lead in the three-match series.

articles.title: Delhi to host the seventieth National School Games in three phases
articles.summary: Delhi will host the seventieth National School Games across three phases featuring fourteen sports disciplines. More than fourteen thousand players and officials are expected to participate in the upcoming multi-sport event. Organizers have announced new facilities, support, and financial incentives to ensure smooth operations and encourage young athletes from across the country.

articles.title: India warns citizens in France, Italy, and Belgium to stay vigilant during protests
articles.summary: India has advised its citizens living in France, Italy, and Belgium to remain cautious amid ongoing protests driven by rising living costs. The Ministry of External Affairs is monitoring the situation and communicating with the local Indian community. Officials recommend avoiding demonstration sites and following all local safety advisories issued by authorities in these European nations.

articles.title: KPMG report outlines blueprint for building sovereign artificial intelligence in India
articles.summary: A new report from KPMG in India outlines a strategic blueprint for developing an independent, inclusive, and future-ready artificial intelligence ecosystem over the next four years. The framework emphasizes controlling critical data, models, and compute infrastructure while ensuring multilingual access and trusted governance. This initiative aims to protect national priorities and drive public services at population scale across the country.

articles.title: Financial Stability and Development Council warns of risks from artificial intelligence
articles.summary: The Financial Stability and Development Council warned of financial risks from artificial intelligence and global uncertainties in New Delhi. Chaired by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Friday, the council urged proactive measures to protect financial stability. Sitharaman called for more frequent meetings to address emerging economic challenges and strengthen the resilience of the financial system against future global shocks.
articles.title_hi: वित्तीय स्थिरता और विकास परिषद ने कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता से होने वाले खतरों के प्रति आगाह किया है

articles.title: Vice-President Releases Book Highlighting India Global Role and Technology
articles.summary: Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan released a new book authored by Anil K. Antony at Uprashtrapati Bhawan in New Delhi on Friday. He emphasized that technological advancements and innovations must benefit all humanity equally. The publication explores India's remarkable transformation, growing international influence, and the vision for inclusive development as the country works toward future progress.

articles.title: BPCL to set up subsidiary for Andhra Pradesh Refinery Project

articles.title: Foreign Funding Behind Protests: Political Bogey Or National Security Threat
articles.summary: On India Today's Democratic Newsroom, anchor Preeti Choudhary leads an editorial debate with journalists Rajdeep Sardesai, Gaurav Sawant, Pooja Shali, and Akshita on allegations of foreign funding and external interference in domestic protests across India. The panel examines whether claims of covert influence represent an established national security issue or a political narrative used to counter public demonstrations.

articles.title: Affiliate urges Centre to deny Starlink licence on security grounds
articles.summary: The Swadeshi Jagran Manch urged the central government in New Delhi on Friday to deny a commercial licence to Elon Musk-owned Starlink. The organisation cited national security risks, arguing that satellite technology could bypass domestic gateways during emergencies and hinder lawful monitoring. Officials are examining the system to ensure regulatory compliance and public safety.

articles.title: India rewrite Asian Para Games record, but not every sport keeps pace
articles.summary: India finished the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya with a record 114 medals, surpassing the country's previous best at the continental event. The final tally of 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals bettered India's 2023 performance in Hangzhou, when the contingent officially finished with 108 medals after three medals were later stripped following doping violations.
articles.title_hi: भारत ने एशियाई पैरा खेलों का रिकॉर्ड फिर से लिखा, लेकिन हर खेल गति बनाए नहीं रखता
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने आइची-नागोया में 2026 एशियाई पैरा खेलों को रिकॉर्ड 114 पदकों के साथ समाप्त किया, जो महाद्वीपीय आयोजन में देश के पिछले सर्वश्रेष्ठ से आगे निकल गया। 30 स्वर्ण, 35 रजत और 49 कांस्य पदकों की अंतिम तालिका ने हांग्जो में भारत के 2023 के प्रदर्शन को बेहतर बना दिया, जब डोपिंग उल्लंघन के बाद तीन पदक छीन लिए जाने के बाद दल आधिकारिक तौर पर 108 पदकों के साथ समाप्त हुआ।
articles.title_hinglish: bharata ne eshiyaee paira khelon ka rikorda phira se likh, lekina hara khela gati banae nahin rakhata

articles.title: Business confidence rebounds in Q2 after four quarters of moderation: NCAER
articles.summary: India's business confidence improved in the second quarter of FY27, reversing four consecutive quarters of moderation, as firms turned more optimistic about economic conditions, sales and investment ahead of the festive season, according to a survey by the National Council of Applied Economic Research (NCAER). articles.title: Gurugram Faces Severe Outages and Water Crisis During Employee Strike

articles.title: Citizen Justice Party Leaders Visit Delhi Police Station Over Jantar Mantar Protest
articles.summary: Citizen Justice Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, and Ajinkya Shinde arrived at Mandir Marg Police Station in Delhi for questioning. The Delhi Police Crime Branch summoned them regarding an October 13 protest at Jantar Mantar where members allegedly trespassed and obstructed officials after the site was de-notified. Ranka and Das recently were released from judicial custody.

articles.title: India Steps Up Indigenous Telecom Research As C-DOT Establishes 6G, AI Centre At IIT
articles.summary: According to a Ministry of Communications release issued on Friday (23 October), C-DOT and IIT BHU signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to facilitate collaborative research, technology development and capacity building in emerging telecommunications technologies. The centre will focus on 5G Advanced and 6G technologies , artificial intelligence-driven communication systems, quantum and post-quantum communications, cybersecurity and advanced wireless networks.

articles.title: Punjab polls: Badal praises SAD-BJP rule as Amit Shah’s NDA pitch fuels reunion buzz
articles.summary: Speculation over a possible reunion between the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) gathered pace on Friday after SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal said his party was open to an alliance with parties that agree with its ideology and programmes, a day after Union home minister Amit Shah predicted an NDA government in Punjab in 2027.

articles.title: BREAKING: Swadeshi Jagran Manch Demands Ban on Starlink, Citing National Security Concerns
articles.summary: The RSS-affiliated Swadeshi Jagran Manch (SJM) has announced a protest in Delhi as it intensifies its campaign against Starlink’s proposed commercial rollout. SJM has urged the Centre to deny Starlink permission to operate, citing concerns over national security, data routing, lawful monitoring and the government’s ability to restrict internet connectivity during emergencies and law-and-order situations.

articles.title: Bomb Threat email targets Chandigarh schools, Punjab Secretariat, Assembly and Mayor’s

articles.summary: Chhattisgarh | Bastar Dussehra | Deities from 50 Formerly Naxal-Affected Villages | Bastar Dussehra for First Time | Bastar Dussehra festival in Chhattisgarh Deities from around 50 villages previously affected by Naxalism participated in the historic Bastar Dussehra festival in Chhattisgarh for the first time this year, following the reported eradication of Naxalism in the region on March 31, 2026.

articles.title: Indian Bank raises fixed deposit rates for senior citizens following repo rate hike

articles.title: India Records 718 Snow Leopards In First National Himalayan Survey
articles.summary: India completed its first national survey of snow leopards and recorded seven hundred eighteen big cats in the Himalayas. This important count helps researchers understand the current population status and distribution of the endangered species across the mountain region for future conservation efforts.

articles.title: Marco Rubio says United States visa rules are global, not targeting India
articles.summary: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated during an India visit that recent work visa and green card program suspensions are global measures prioritizing American workers. The United States government suspended major information technology firms from the Permanent Labour Certification Program due to active federal investigations. Rubio emphasized the changes address a broken immigration system affecting every country worldwide.

articles.title: Kolkata Durga idol immersion delayed after stampede claims nineteen lives
articles.summary: The Durga idol at Chorbagan in Kolkata remains alone and its immersion is on hold following a stampede during Saptami that claimed nineteen lives. articles.title: Only ‘Sanatanis’ Can Touch Durga Idols At Immersion Ghats: Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari

articles.title: ITBP chief says China face-offs ongoing along Arunachal, Congress attacks PM
articles.summary: It marks the first official confirmation of ongoing face-offs on the north-eastern border in Arunachal, where the situation has grown increasingly tense in recent months. articles.title_hi: आईटीबीपी प्रमुख का कहना है कि अरुणाचल सीमा पर चीन के साथ आमना-सामना जारी है

articles.title: Trump declares wind turbine imports as threat to national security; India among top
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump recently declared that imports of wind turbines pose a threat to national security. The declaration followed a Commerce Department investigation focusing on cybersecurity issues related to foreign-made equipment. Trump cited concerns regarding foreign reliance and interruptions to radar systems and air traffic operations. Instead of imposing immediate tariffs, he directed trade officials to negotiate with partners.
